messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth
function.description: Establishes a connection to a Bluetooth device using its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

device_name.description: The name of the Bluetooth device to connect to.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to attempt a connection before timing out.

auto_reconnect.description: Whether to automatically attempt to reconnect if the connection is lost.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, creating a three‑day break that includes at least one weekend day.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if needed) | Long‑weekend span |
|---------|-------------|----------------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Observed Monday Jan 2 | **Dec 30 – Jan 2** |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20 – May 22** |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Observed Friday Jun 30 | **Jun 30 – Jul 2** |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** |
| **Remembrance Day** | Saturday Nov 11 | Observed Friday Nov 10 | **Nov 10 – Nov 12** |
| **Christmas** | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** |

> **Notes**  
> * Some holidays (e.g., Canada Day, Remembrance Day) fall on a weekend, so the statutory holiday is observed on the nearest weekday.  
> * The table reflects the federal statutory holidays that create a three‑day break. Provincial holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Ontario on Feb 20, or St. Patrick’s Day in some provinces) are not listed here but can be added if you need province‑specific data.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
